title: Microsoft Teams: shared call history in the Queues app on mobile
summary: The mobile rollout and its administrative settings are supported, but the licensing classification needs correction: this change is included in the licences existing Queues app users already require, rather than a separate add-on. Some navigation details and checklist-to-table omissions also need clarification.

claims.quote: Calling reps and Supervisor leads can view shared call history for their call queues in the Queues app on Mobile

Cite that guide.

Opened manage-queues-app, aa-cq-plan-shared-call-history, aa-cq-setup-call-queue-template-shared-history, aa-cq-reference-prerequisites-licensing; read roadmap and MC1556098. claims.claim: The mobile shared call history change has an add-on licensing model.
claims.quote: Page: licensing.model: add-on. Notice: shared call history in the Queues app, which is included with a Teams Premium license.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included': this mobile extension is part of the Teams Premium entitlement the Queues app already requires. Retain the notes that users need both Teams Phone and Teams Premium; this does not mean Teams Premium itself is free or a base Teams entitlement.
